2.12.1 Image.Name
The Image.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for an Image instance. This attribute MUST be
specified. The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15]
that is unique for all report items in a Report.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Name attribute.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
